summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by Unilever PLC, a UK-based foreign private issuer, reporting director/PDMR shareholdings. The filing details dividend reinvestment transactions by CFO Srinivas Phatak and two other executives, involving small volumes of ordinary shares in GBP and EUR on the London and Amsterdam exchanges. There is no corporate event, transaction, or special situation; it is only an insider dealing notification equivalent to a US Form 4. No deal terms exist. Observe that this is a standard ownership disclosure without any strategic or structural implications.
